item.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 24.6 million copies by the end of launch day, Sensor Tower says
item.description: The analytics firm puts Rockstar's first-day haul at roughly $2.36 billion including preorders, about three times GTA V's 2013 opening. Take-Two hasn't confirmed any numbers yet.

item.title: GTA VI breaks the all-time streaming record for a game launch
item.description: Streams Charts tracked a combined peak of more than 6 million concurrent viewers across YouTube, Twitch and Kick, smashing Valorant's 2020 beta record several times over.

item.title: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs at its Montreal and Quebec City studios
item.description: The layoffs mainly hit production and support roles tied to cancelled or reworked projects, extending a year of closures and cuts at the Assassin's Creed publisher.

item.title: Steam Machine 512GB is now in stock, but Valve warns prices may rise
item.description: Valve has cleared its reservation queue for the base model and closed the 2TB waitlist, while warning that soaring memory and storage costs could push prices up again.

item.title: Rockstar developers say layoff fears linger even after GTA VI's record launch
item.description: A Rockstar animation programmer argues union recognition would give staff a voice as the industry braces for post-launch cuts and AI. The vote runs until November 26.

item.title: GTA VI is out now after preorders reportedly topped $1.65 billion
item.description: Rockstar's open-world sequel has unlocked worldwide on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Sensor Tower estimates preorders alone passed $1.65 billion, with about three quarters on PS5.

item.title: PlayStation Network outage hits players hours before GTA VI unlocks
item.description: Sony acknowledged sign-in and connection problems on Wednesday afternoon as PS5 owners prepared for GTA VI. Service was reportedly back before the US launch, but a second blip followed.

item.title: Sony wins UK class action over PlayStation Store prices
item.description: London's Competition Appeal Tribunal has dismissed a $2.6 billion claim that Sony abused its control of digital game sales on PlayStation with a 30 percent cut.

item.title: European game worker unions call for an end to generative AI use where possible
item.description: Unions in the UK, Ireland, Spain and Italy have published a joint manifesto arguing that generative AI is costing jobs and making working conditions worse.

item.title: Ghost of Yotei, Marvel's Wolverine and 007 First Light lead Grammy video game nominees
item.description: Five scores are up for the Grammy for best video game soundtrack, while the team behind Unbeatable says its vocal-heavy music was a poor fit for the category.

item.title: Black Friday 2026: Nintendo eShop and Xbox sales start this week
item.description: Nintendo's eShop sale begins today and a $499.99 Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle follows on November 22. Xbox's sale offers up to 80% off games from tonight.

item.title: Xbox Game Pass adds The Outlast Trials, Hela and Arkheron in late November
item.description: Microsoft's second November wave brings High on Life 2, Motorslice and two day-one launches, while eight games including Aliens: Dark Descent leave on November 30.

item.title: GTA VI reviews are in, and it just tied the highest Metacritic score ever
item.description: Rockstar's game opened at 99 on Metacritic when the review embargo lifted, matching Ocarina of Time's 1998 record. Here's what critics loved and what they didn't.

item.title: What time does GTA VI unlock? Launch times by region
item.description: GTA VI unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, so New Zealand plays first and the Americas last. In the US, that means 9 PM Pacific tonight.

item.title: GTA VI runs at 30fps on every console: resolutions, PS5 Pro extras and the update you need
item.description: There's no performance mode in GTA VI. Rockstar says 30fps was always the target on this generation of hardware. Here's how each console renders the game.

item.title: Firaxis cuts about a third of its staff as layoffs hit Crystal Dynamics and Netflix Games
item.description: The Civilization studio loses around 60 people, per Bloomberg, in a week of cuts across the industry.

item.title: The Game Awards 2026 nominees: GTA VI leads with eight, Ocarina of Time remake in the GOTY race
item.description: Six games are up for Game of the Year at the December 10 show, and fan voting is open now.

item.title: The hacker behind the 2022 GTA VI leak pleads guilty
item.description: Arion Kurtaj, who posted about 90 clips of an early GTA VI build, admitted the Rockstar breach in a London court three days before launch.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake sells 5.2 million in four days, a Switch 2 record
item.description: Nintendo's rebuilt classic is now the fastest-selling game on Switch 2.

item.title: Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at MachineGames
item.description: Xbox confirmed the sequel as part of its 25th anniversary celebrations, nine years after The New Colossus.

item.title: God of War Sons of Sparta comes to PS4 with two free new modes
item.description: The 2D Kratos prequel is no longer PS5-only. A free update on both consoles adds a speedrun mode and a brutal one-hit mode.

item.title: Xbox turns 25: everything announced, from Wolfenstein 3 to original Xbox games on PC
item.description: Microsoft marked the anniversary with new games in production, more classic Xbox titles on PC, fresh Fable gameplay and the $900 Series X25.

item.title: Rockstar's UK staff vote on union recognition during GTA VI launch week
item.description: The ballot runs from November 12 to 26. A yes vote would create the largest recognized union in the UK games industry.

item.title: id Software starts its next game, with Doom's Hugo Martin directing
item.description: The Doom studio confirmed a new project across its Texas and Frankfurt teams. It hasn't said what the game is, but reports point to more Doom.

item.title: Witcher 3's new expansion uses AI to keep Geralt's Polish voice consistent
item.description: Geralt's Polish actor Jacek Rozenek still records every line. AI adjusts them to match his voice from before a 2019 stroke, with his consent.

item.title: EU proposes banning paid loot boxes and pay-to-win for minors
item.description: The Digital Fairness Act would also force games to show loot box odds and let every player switch paid loot boxes off. Industry groups are pushing back.

item.title: PlayStation cancels Fairgames, but Haven Studios keeps its staff
item.description: The heist shooter revealed in 2023 is dead after a playtest missed internal targets. No one is losing their job.

item.title: Switch 2 reaches 26.35 million sold as Nintendo holds its 16.5 million forecast
item.description: Hardware sales are down from launch year, but software is up and Nintendo is sticking to its full-year target despite rising chip costs.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches, Blizzard's long-awaited Classic Plus
item.description: A third permanent version of WoW expands vanilla Azeroth with new zones, dungeons and over 1,000 quests. Raids open December 9.

item.title: God of War Laufey is delayed three months to May 20, 2027
item.description: Santa Monica Studio is pushing Faye's PS5 adventure back from February to give the game more polish.
